description: Use this when the user asks who funds work on a target, drug, process or lab, how much and since when. Aging research grants from NIH, the EU (CORDIS), UKRI and Wellcome, newest award first: title, funder, holder, investigators, amount, period and a link to the record. For company financings use list_news.

cursor.description: From the last page's `pagination.next_cursor`; keep the other arguments the same.

entity.description: Only grants whose titles name this entity, as `type:key` (see /entities), e.g. `intervention:rapamycin` or `disease:sarcopenia`.

funder.description: Only grants from this funder, by its organization key or name, e.g. `nia` or `wellcome`.

holder.description: Only grants held by this organization (its key) or investigator (`person:` and their key), e.g. `buck-institute-for-research-on-aging`.

q.description: Words of the grant's title ("quoted phrases", OR and -exclusions work).

since.description: Only grants awarded on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

until.description: Only grants awarded on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: list_grants
